title: Credit freeze after identity theft
facts: A security freeze restricts prospective creditors from accessing a consumer's credit file, making it harder for an identity thief to open new credit accounts.
Federal law allows consumers to place and lift security freezes for free.
A freeze must generally be placed separately with Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion.
A credit freeze does not prevent all forms of identity theft and does not replace monitoring existing accounts.
